AT0099.title: GOIP Gateway Device
AT0099.description: A GOIP device is a VoIP gateway that converts SIP/network calls into cellular wireless signals, enabling remote internet-based control of multiple SIM cards for dialing, SMS send/receive, and call answering. GOIP allows the SIM-card pool to be placed at the device location while being remotely operated over the internet from elsewhere, achieving person-card and machine-card separation — making it core hardware infrastructure for SMS-receiving platforms (AT0006) and fraud gangs' remote dialing and SMS verification. GOIP devices support multi-channel concurrency (commonly 8/16/32/64 channels) and are used with cat pools (AT0004) to batch-manage large numbers of SIM cards. Because it can be remotely operated, is highly concealable, and supports hot-swappable SIM rotation, it is often used to bypass SMS verification (A0007-001), number-region risk control, and IP intelligence (A0016-001). Distinguish from AT0004 cat pool: a cat pool is a hardware device for multi-card SMS send/receive, whereas GOIP is a gateway between VoIP and cellular networks, focused on remote call and dialing capability, often remotely operated for fraud and SMS-receiving.
